description: Read the state of a job you submitted, its queue position and wait estimate while it is queued, its payment state, and the names of its deliverables. Requires the job_id and the access_token returned at acceptance. Use this to monitor execution; use get_job_result to fetch the deliverable itself.

access_token.description: The access_token returned with the job. It is the only credential that opens the job, and it is shown once, at acceptance.

job_id.description: The job_id returned when the job was accepted.

name: get_job_status

progress.description: Where the job is and what to do next. While queued it carries queue_position, jobs_ahead and an estimated_wait_s measured from completed jobs; it never invents a wait.

artifacts.description: Deliverable names; fetch the content with get_job_result.

title: Check a SwishrJobs job
